caption: The drawing depicts a powder horn, elongated and slightly curved, with a dark brown tip and base, and a brass or wood ring for attachment at the broader end. The central body of the horn is a light tan color, covered with etched illustrations and text resembling an old map. The map displays various buildings, cities, rivers, roads, and labeled locations, with the city of “New York” prominently marked in the lower half, surrounded by detailed clusters of small buildings. Several other settlements and landmarks are present, indicated by schematic depictions of fortifications and flags. The horn is shown isolated against a plain, off-white background, with no additional objects or decorations in the composition. The name "Wm. McGuely" appears in small text in the lower right corner.
title: Powder Horn
